//! Exercise the embedded TLS initializer's unwind paths with host Rust.
extern crate alloc as alloc_crate;
extern crate self as core;

pub use std::{cell, error, fmt, mem, ops, ptr, sync};

pub mod io {
    pub fn flush_stdout() {
        use std::io::Write;
        std::io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
    }
}

#[path = __TLS_DIRECTORY__]
mod thread {
    #[path = "local.rs"]
    pub mod local;
}

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use thread::local::LocalKey;

#[test]
fn panicking_initializer_can_be_retried() {
    static ATTEMPTS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
    static KEY: LocalKey<usize> = LocalKey::__new(|| {
        assert_ne!(ATTEMPTS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed), 0, "first attempt");
        41
    });
    std::thread::spawn(|| {
        assert!(std::panic::catch_unwind(|| KEY.with(|_| ())).is_err());
        KEY.with(|value| assert_eq!(*value, 41));
        KEY.with(|value| assert_eq!(*value, 41));
    })
    .join()
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ATTEMPTS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 2);
}

#[test]
fn cell_set_skips_the_initializer_and_reuses_storage() {
    static KEY: LocalKey<cell::Cell<u32>> = LocalKey::__new(|| panic!("must not initialize"));
    std::thread::spawn(|| {
        KEY.set(7);
        assert_eq!(KEY.get(), 7);
        KEY.set(19);
        assert_eq!(KEY.get(), 19);
    })
    .join()
    .unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn replacing_noncopy_cell_payloads_drops_each_value_once() {
    static DROPS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
    struct Tracked;
    impl Drop for Tracked {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            DROPS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    static KEY: LocalKey<cell::Cell<Tracked>> = LocalKey::__new(|| panic!("must not initialize"));
    std::thread::spawn(|| {
        KEY.set(Tracked);
        assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 0);
        KEY.set(Tracked);
        assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
    })
    .join()
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 2);
}
